composition.description: The composition of a insulation material

name.description: The name of a insulation material

minimumBendRadius.description: Smallest centreline radius the material can be bent to, per size, for a material of form 'sleeve' (tubing over a lead). The bend radius of tubing depends on its size and wall -- Zeus measures its PTFE tubing at roughly ten times its outside diameter, and states it is governed by 'outside diameter (OD) of the tubing, wall thickness, and resin' -- so it is given per point rather than as one number. A consumer uses the point matching the sleeve it drew; with no matching point it has no rated value and must not invent one. Every point carries the provenance of the figure.

relativePermittivity.description: The dielectric constant of the insulation material

thermalConductivity.description: Thermal conductivity of the insulation material. Unit: W/(m*K).

specificHeat.description: Specific heat capacity of the insulation material. Unit: J/(kg*K).

temperatureClass.description: Insulation thermal class per IEC 60085. May be expressed as the IEC letter class (Y, A, E, B, F, H, N, R, 200, 220, 250) or as the numeric maximum continuous operating temperature in Celsius (the form printed on most magnet-wire spools and IEC 60317 sub-spec datasheets). The two forms are interchangeable per the IEC 60085 mapping. See docs/normative-references.md.

meltingPoint.description: The melting temperature of the insulation material, in Celsius

resistivity.description: Volume resistivity per IEC 60093. Unit: ohm metre (Ohm.m).

surfaceResistivity.description: Surface resistivity per IEC 60093. Unit: ohm per square (Ohm/sq). Relevant to tracking and creepage assessment per IEC 60112 / IEC 60664-1.

form.description: The form the material is supplied in, which decides where it can be used: tape is wound on, film is placed as a sheet, sleeve is slid over a lead, varnish is impregnated.

cti.description: Comparative tracking index of the material per IEC 60112, the voltage at which it withstands 50 drops of test solution without tracking. Unit: V. The material group used in insulation coordination (I, II, IIIA, IIIB) follows from it per IEC 60664-1.

dielectricStrengthPoint.description: data for describing one point of dielectric strength

value.description: Dielectric strength value, in V / m

temperature.description: Temperature for the field value, in Celsius.

humidity.description: Humidity for the field value, in proportion over 1

minimumBendRadiusPoint.description: One rated minimum bend radius of a tubing size

value.description: Minimum centreline bend radius, in m

innerDiameter.description: Inner diameter of the tubing size the value is for, in m

wallThickness.description: Wall thickness of the tubing size the value is for, in m

provenance.description: Where the value comes from: the manufacturer's measured or rated figure, never an estimate.
